WITH _base AS (
  SELECT
    orders.status AS "customers.orders.status"
  FROM customers AS customers
  LEFT JOIN orders AS orders
    ON customers.id = orders.customer_id
  GROUP BY
    orders.status
), _cm_customers__credit_sum AS (
  SELECT
    _base."customers.orders.status" AS "customers.orders.status",
    CAST(SUM(_base._v) AS DOUBLE) AS "customers.credit_sum_host"
  FROM (
    SELECT
      orders.status AS "customers.orders.status",
      customers.id AS _ek0,
      MAX(customers.credit) AS _v
    FROM customers AS customers
    LEFT JOIN orders AS orders
      ON customers.id = orders.customer_id
    WHERE
      NOT customers.id IS NULL
    GROUP BY
      orders.status,
      customers.id
  ) AS _base
  GROUP BY
    _base."customers.orders.status"
), _cm_customers___count AS (
  SELECT
    _base."customers.orders.status" AS "customers.orders.status",
    COUNT(*) AS "customers._count_host"
  FROM (
    SELECT
      orders.status AS "customers.orders.status",
      customers.id AS _ek0
    FROM customers AS customers
    LEFT JOIN orders AS orders
      ON customers.id = orders.customer_id
    WHERE
      NOT customers.id IS NULL
    GROUP BY
      orders.status,
      customers.id
  ) AS _base
  GROUP BY
    _base."customers.orders.status"
)
SELECT
  _base."customers.orders.status",
  _cm_customers__credit_sum."customers.credit_sum_host" AS "customers.total_credit",
  COALESCE(_cm_customers___count."customers._count_host", 0) AS "customers.n"
FROM _base
LEFT JOIN _cm_customers__credit_sum
  ON _base."customers.orders.status" IS NOT DISTINCT FROM _cm_customers__credit_sum."customers.orders.status"
LEFT JOIN _cm_customers___count
  ON _base."customers.orders.status" IS NOT DISTINCT FROM _cm_customers___count."customers.orders.status"
LIMIT 21

args.message: Total customer credit limit by order status: ok = 111,230 (201 customers) and bad = 92,580 (169 customers). Each customer's credit is counted once per status, so a customer with many orders isn't counted repeatedly. A customer who has orders of both statuses is counted under both, which means the two totals overlap and shouldn't be added together. One customer with no orders (credit 600) isn't in either total.
